title: Rename a template's dependent name
summary: In a template, a call depending on a template parameter is renamed where the indexed instantiations resolve it to the renamed method; one another instantiation resolves to another method of the same name stops the rename, and one no instantiation resolves is left alone and named in a message

rename.error: cannot rename `area`: the name at ${WS}/main.cpp:17 also refers to `Triangle::area` in another instantiation or build configuration: rename both to `side` in one list of renames

rename.notice:
Spellings of `area` left alone:
  ${WS}/main.cpp:25: double size_of(const Box<T>& box) { return box.area(); } (in a template, where no instantiation the index saw resolves the name to it)
